doubts: The page starts at St Arnaud and offers two ways to the Cascade Track junction (via Lakehead Hut or via Coldwater Hut), so both are ways from St Arnaud, and Lakehead Hut is the main way as the first option named. St Arnaud is named in the text but matches no feature or name entry, so its ref is null. The DOC time 6 hr and distance 9.4 km one way match the hut-to-Angelus part of the route, not the whole way from St Arnaud, so no time or distance is given for either way. The note about the unbridged Travers River is not tied to one leg; it is recorded on both ways. The Robert Ridge Route and Mt Cedric Track are mentioned only as other routes.
